title: Empowering communities on land and at sea
tagline: Empowering Communities · Protecting the Environment · Advancing Maritime Growth
intro: Corporate social responsibility is at the heart of KSL’s mission. Programmes empower communities, promote environmental stewardship, and drive socio economic transformation across Kenya and Eastern Africa.
footnote: Community programme figures reflect KSL CSR reporting (2020 to 2025). Environmental performance is covered on Sustainability.
